content.text:
I'm marking this case **incomplete**. Nothing in it calls for declining or escalating, but one required fact isn't established yet: whether Hana Silva's identity has been verified.

**Ownership (3.3).** Vera Weiss holds 25% and Jia Nakamura 32%. Ember Holdings LLC holds 43%, so its owners count as indirect owners. Wen Weiss holds 20% × 43% = 8.6%, below the 25% threshold. Hana Silva holds 80% × 43% = 34.4%, so she must be identified. All shares are accounted for, so ownership is complete.

**Verification (3.4).** Vera Weiss, Jia Nakamura and Wen Weiss are verified. Hana Silva's verification status is "unknown". Under 2.2, an unknown fact is not the same as a false one. We haven't established that she failed verification, only that we don't know whether she passed. That makes this incomplete under Section 1 rather than a document request under 3.4. The rule can be read the other way, though. If a reviewer treats "unknown" as "unverified", the outcome becomes request documents.

**Everything else is clean:**
- **Control person (3.2):** Vera Weiss, Chief Executive Officer.
- **Registry filing (3.5):** filed 2026-10-18, well under 12 months old.
- **Screening (4.1–4.4):** no sanctions matches, PEPs or adverse media on the entity or any of the four people. The file reports adverse media only as "no". It doesn't include the search terms, dates and sources that 4.4 says to record.
- **Industry (5):** "normal". The unverified licence only matters for money services businesses, so it doesn't apply.
- **Geography (6):** the entity and all four people are US-located.

Because Hana Silva's status is unknown, 2.2 means the case can't be approved.
